reuse.why: Reuses getDateWithSkippedWeekend, getNextDate and d.isWeekend, but getUpcomingDates and schedule-template re-derive the daily-vs-move decision instead of extending the shared weekend helper to take the frequency.

duplication.why: The 'daily skips weekends, others move them' condition is written three times (skipsWeekendDays in getNextDate, movesWeekends in schedule-template, skipDailyWeekends in getUpcomingDates), each with its own filtering/moving branch.

placement.why: The core change in shared/schedules getNextDate is in the right layer, but the budget template and the schedules app handler each carry their own copy of the rule rather than delegating to shared/schedules.

scope.why: Edits are confined to the weekend rule and passing frequency through parseRecurDate; nothing unrelated.

maintainability.why: Three diverging encodings of the same rule plus the opaque 'movesWeekends || !skipWeekend' flag passed as noSkipWeekend in schedule-template make the next weekend-rule change easy to get wrong in one place.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates and server/budget/schedule-template.ts createScheduleList decide daily skipping themselves instead of going through shared/schedules getNextDate/getDateWithSkippedWeekend for the decision.

disguised_duplication.where: The daily-skip condition is renamed and reshaped at each site: skipsWeekendDays + isKept filter in shared/schedules.ts getNextDate, movesWeekends in budget/schedule-template.ts, skipDailyWeekends loop in schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates.

one_place.where: The rule lands separately in shared/schedules.ts getNextDate, server/budget/schedule-template.ts createScheduleList and server/schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates.
